summary: Iteration 4 Mobile Form UX testing complete. Fixed Login page form width/centering issue. All mobile responsive features verified: Login form now fills viewport width (358px on 390px viewport), properly centered, title 'Welcome Back' on single line. critical_code_review_comments: Login.js had a CSS issue where flex container with justify-center prevented w-full from expanding the child. Fixed by adding flex-col to the parent container.
The popup-overlay CSS media query for mobile (max-width: 640px) correctly implements bottom sheet pattern with align-items: flex-end, full width, and slideUp animation.
